Package io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.components

package io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.components
Building blocks used by the game, such as the map, item data, hidden events, waves, sounds and the student controller.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    io.mapjhak.goosepatrol
    Entry point of the game, which opens the title screen.
    io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.entities
    Objects that exist in the game world: the student, geese, items and projectiles, all based on Entity.
    io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.managers
    Classes that run the game, including the timer, geese, waves, hidden events and debug tools.
    io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.screens
    The game's screens: title, setup, settings, gameplay and end screen.
  • Class
    Description
    GameMap
    GameMap manages the tile map, detects collisions checks for Circles, holds collision information via an array of Rectangles, and decides were the Student appears at spawn
    HiddenEvent
    HiddenEvent stores a single instance of a secret event in the map, Each instance is managed together by the HiddenEventManager
    HiddenEvent.EventType
    EventType stores the types of events possible
    ItemData
    ItemData stores information about items as a single contained unit to make transfer of item data easier.
    ItemType
    ItemType enumerates possible items (including a "missing item" type).
    MapSettings
    MapSettings stores the state of the map to choose between the two maps
    SfxMusic
    SfxMusic stores Sound objects for sound effects, and a Music object for the music
    StudentController
    StudentController manages inputs for a given Student
    Wave
    Wave stores information about each wave.
